name: Skuld
source:
Skuld is one of the three Norns. Her role within the three Norns is unclear. Mythology seems to imply that she is related to what needs to occur, essentially the future, but her exact purpose is unknown.

In terms of her personality, she is very caring and affectionate to those she loves.

[In game description]
